entities.summary: Latvia is a sovereign nation in Northern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Riga. Official languages include Latvian. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 1.9 million. Area: 64,559 km². Comprehensive index for Latvia covering Baltic tribes (Livonians, Latgalians, Curonians, Semigallians), Northern Crusades (Livonian Order, 13th century), Livonian Confederation, Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Swedish Empire (1629-1721), Russian Empire (1721-1918), national awakening (19th century), first independence 1918, Soviet occupation 1940, Nazi occupation 1941-44, Soviet re-occupation 1944-91, Baltic Way 1989, restored independence 1991, EU/NATO 2004.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Latvia played a significant role in the Baltic Way protests of 1989, which marked a major turning point in the country's struggle for independence from Soviet occupation. The event drew hundreds of thousands of people across the three Baltic states, demonstrating widespread resistance to communist rule.
